source: maxLoggedBodyBytes and maxEventLogSizeInBytes changed through PUT /mockserver/configuration are echoed by GET /mockserver/configuration but have no effect on the running event log, not even after a reset (probed against the oracle 2026-10-03; maxLogEntries is the same and is covered by configuration_runtime_update). Its own server so the changed configuration does not leak into other scenarios.

steps.note: logged whole: no limit in force
still logged whole: the new limit does not reach the event log
a budget smaller than what the log already holds: nothing is evicted
a reset does not apply them either
both values are reported as set
